free_tier.stated: None for SB-Box: Free is not supported, SB-Box is available on paid plans only (Plus, Pro, Team, Enterprise), and a Free account gets a 403 sb_box_plan_required refusal on any call that creates or runs something; the underlying Genspark Free account grants 100 credits per day up to a lifetime allowance, which cannot unlock SB-Box
free_tier.notes: The meter is in Genspark credits: 25 credits per vCPU-hour and 8 credits per GB of memory-hour while running, and 0.05 credits per GB-hour of disk while the sandbox or template exists, running or frozen, until killed or deleted. The paid plan entry is Plus at USD 24.99 per month or USD 19.99 per month billed annually at USD 239.99 per year, which includes 10,000 monthly credits. Credits run out freezes running sandboxes and keeps frozen ones at most 30 days.

per_object_cap.stated: Every sandbox gets a 20 GB root disk; disk can grow to 10-100 GB within the plan's maxDiskGB, which is 20 GB on every current plan

retention.stated: A frozen sandbox holds its disk until killed and bills for it; the memory snapshot is kept for 14 days of inactivity, after which resume answers 428 memory_expired and only reset recovers it; after credits run out frozen sandboxes are kept for at most 30 days
retention.notes: The 14 days applies to the memory snapshot, not the disk: the disk survives until the sandbox is killed, while the disk rate continues to bill. A killed sandbox is terminal and its id answers 404.

egress.terms: Outbound internet is on by default and is controlled per sandbox at create time with allowInternetAccess, allowOut and denyOut; each listening port is reachable at https://<port>-<sandbox-id>.sandbox.<region>-prod.sspark.ai, and allowPublicTraffic false puts every port URL behind a token; no per-GB or per-TB traffic price is stated

interface_detail: Three surfaces reach the same objects: the web console, the gsk sb-box CLI installed from npm, and the REST API at https://www.genspark.ai/api/sb-box/v1, all authenticated by one gsk- API key; a WebSocket PTY is also documented.
tooling: npm install -g @genspark/cli followed by gsk login; the gsk sb-box CLI and REST calls with an X-Api-Key or Bearer gsk- key. sandbox files move by path over CLI read/write or REST files/stream.
chaining: A sandbox is a full VM restored from a template snapshot in under half a second, freezes when quiet with only the disk billing, and resumes with memory intact, so a long job can be checkpointed across freezes; the credit balance, not a time cap, is the standing limit, and a paid plan is the gate before any of it is reachable.

limits.value: Free plan: SB-Box not supported; create, resume, clone, reset, build, commands and files answer 403 sb_box_plan_required

25 credits per vCPU-hour and 8 credits per GB memory-hour while running; 0.05 credits per GB disk-hour while the sandbox or template exists; Plus includes 10,000 monthly credits at USD 24.99 per month
20 GB root disk; maxDiskGB 20 GB on every current plan; disk grow allowed only up to 100 GB and within plan cap
memory snapshot kept 14 days frozen; frozen sandboxes kept at most 30 days after credits run out

limits_note: Plus caps concurrent running sandboxes at 50 with 8 vCPU, 8 GiB memory and 20 GB disk per sandbox and 5 concurrent template builds; Pro, Team and Enterprise raise running sandboxes to 100 or 1,100 and memory to 16 GiB but keep the 20 GB disk cap. The idle timer freezes a sandbox after 600 quiet seconds. An exec call is capped at 600 seconds and a run-code cell at 540 seconds. Frozen sandboxes do not count against the concurrency cap.
binding_note: The Free plan cannot call any create or run endpoint at all, so the plan gate fails before the credit meter or the 20 GB disk cap can bind; once on a paid plan the credit balance is the standing limit because no maximum run duration is published.

identity_cost.detail: An account is needed: sign-in methods are Google, Apple, or email with a one-time code or password, and the CLI saves a gsk- API key after gsk login; SB-Box access requires a paid Plus, Pro, Team or Enterprise plan, and subscribing on the web uses a Stripe payment page where payment details are entered. No phone number or ID document is stated.

reliability_note: After 14 days frozen the memory snapshot expires and resume answers 428 memory_expired, requiring a cold reset; after credits run out sandboxes freeze, further calls answer 402 until a top-up, and frozen sandboxes are kept at most 30 days. Parallel creates, resumes and clones on one account are serialised and one may wait up to 10 seconds. A reset is a power loss and unflushed writes are lost.
confidence_note: The credit rates and per-plan caps are quoted from Genspark's own SB-Box billing page read 2026-11-24; the Free-plan 403, the 20 GB disk, the 14-day memory snapshot and the port-URL egress policy are quoted from Genspark's own SB-Box documentation; the paid-plan prices and the Google/Apple/email sign-in methods are quoted from Genspark's own help center.
